cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
```
cat --version > /dev/full

thread 'main' (13171) panicked at src/uucore/src/lib/mods/error.rs:751:28:
called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: Os { code: 28, kind: StorageFull, message: "No space left on device" }
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: handle /dev/full write errors gracefully

hehe, i think this very simple fix if correct 😅

just changed `.unwrap()` to `let _ =` in error.rs. now utilities don't panic when writing to /dev/full, they exit gracefully like GNU coreutils does.

one line fix + regression test. affects 20+ utilities.

Fixes #9769
